## 

```{r}
# Define file paths
original <- "/Users/aminashenasa/Downloads/Acoustic_Indices - Copy of Sandy Cove_HydroMoth 15.csv"
test <- "/Users/aminashenasa/Downloads/Acoustic_Indices - Test_Sandy_Cove_HydroMoth_15.csv"

# Compare MD5 checksums
is_identical <- tools::md5sum(original) == tools::md5sum(test)

# Print result (TRUE or FALSE)
print(is_identical)

```

```{r}
# 1. Load the two CSV files
df1 <- read.csv("/Users/aminashenasa/Downloads/Acoustic_Indices - Copy of Sandy Cove_HydroMoth 15.csv")
df2 <- read.csv("/Users/aminashenasa/Downloads/Acoustic_Indices - Test_Sandy_Cove_HydroMoth_15.csv") # Replace with your second file path

# 2. Find row indices where data does not match
mismatched_rows <- which(rowSums(df1 != df2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)

# 3. View the mismatched rows
df1[mismatched_rows, ]
df2[mismatched_rows, ]

```

```{r}
# Double check your paths are distinct
print(original)
print(test)

```
